text:
nori: deploy-bot alerted on a rising 5xx rate for streaming responses in hosted-us-east1 during our midroll. p99 errors up ~6% vs baseline, trigger_count=3. auto-revert threshold is 3.

deploy-bot: ALERT: hosted/us-east1 | route=streaming | p99_errors=6% (+) | trigger_count=3 | auto_revert_threshold=3 | action=AUTOREVERT_POSSIBLE

chris: i'm oncall and on the midroll. we promised a coordinated ramp with product this hour. an automatic revert would flip the traffic and confuse customers. request human hold and quick triage.

ops-bot: NOTE: Auto-revert policy active during change window. Human hold can be set to suppress: `deploybot.hold=true`. Hold will persist until unset or window close.

linda: i'm awake. quick triage: check sidecar logs and stream broker backpressure. nori, paste recent `kubectl logs` snippet?

nori: logs show intermittent `stream_worker_restart` and `grpc: connection reset by peer` from the stream proxy, not immediate model errors. CPU/GPU normal. Pasting sample: ```
# tail -n 60 svc/streaming-canary
2026-02-10T03:45:12Z stream_worker_restart id=9
2026-02-10T03:45:14Z grpc: connection reset by peer
2026-02-10T03:45:18Z stream_worker_restart id=9
```

chris: seems like a proxy/broker regression from the new proxy image we rolled. prefer to 1) hold autosafe 2) do a targeted rollback of proxy sidecar image in the canary slice 3) avoid flipping model variants.

linda: agree. set hold please. we want minimal blast.

chris: setting `deploybot.hold=true` now -> done. deploy-bot: hold acknowledged by chris at 4476001245.

ops-bot: RUNBOOK: hold prevents auto-revert. Suggested action: sidecar image rollback for streaming canary only. Use `infractl image set --service=stream-proxy --region=us-east1 --variant=proxy-stable-1.3 --slice=canary`. Verify healthchecks.

nori: executing partial rollback command at 4476001250: `infractl image set --service=stream-proxy --region=us-east1 --slice=canary --tag=proxy-stable-1.3 --note="proxy-sidecar_regression"` -> api ok.

qa-bot: REMINDER: run stream smoke test after image change: `scripts/smoke_stream.sh --region=us-east1 --slice=canary` and confirm p99 < baseline+1% for 5m.

linda: smoke run returned green in 45s. p99 errors back to 0.8% (baseline ~0.6%). healthchecks 3/3.

deploy-bot: LOG: autorevert suppressed due to hold=true by chris. manual sidecar rollback completed at 4476001254.

chris: good. plan now: keep hold for 30m while we monitor, do not unhold until product confirms midroll state and sales is notified. also draft a short customer note if any external alpha testers saw interruptions.

sales-bot: affected accounts: BetaStudy (test-slice) and DevKit (canary). Draft message: "We observed transient stream interruptions during a canary roll. We've reverted the proxy sidecar in the affected slice and are monitoring. No data exposure. Contact us if you saw issues."

linda: posted to #customer-impact and CC'd product and sales.

ops-bot: RUNBOOK STEP: create incident if recurrence occurs or errors exceed baseline+2% for 5m. Otherwise log as post-deploy blip and open follow-up ticket for proxy image gating in CI.

nori: creating INC-2026-999 with logs, infractl commands, and smoke results. assigning to eng-runtime and infra-sre for RCA. ETA 24h for initial triage.

chris: metadata note: `rollback.partial=sidecar_proxy`, `rollback.scope=canary-us-east1`, `operator=chris`, `started=4476001250`.

ops-bot: REMINDER: unsetting `deploybot.hold` requires two approvers during change window. Use `deploybot.unhold=true --approvals=2` or wait for window close.

sales-bot: holding sales comms until eng-runtime posts RCA or confirms stable after 30m.

linda: monitoring looks stable at +12m. I'll leave hold; we'll schedule a controlled re-roll of the proxy image through CI gating with a canary job. Ticket INFRA-553 created for gating + auto-block.

chris: thanks. closing thread for now. if deploy-bot re-triggers, ping @oncall immediately. :thumbsup:
